assignments.name: promql
assignments.value: label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, "digest_kind", "alert", "alertname", ".*") or label_replace(up{cluster=~"ggg|khb|ljw|nmg|oje",job=~"host-vm|kubernetes-nodes|kube-state-metrics"}, "digest_kind", "up", "job", ".*") or label_replace(min_over_time(up{cluster=~"ggg|khb|ljw|nmg|oje",job=~"host-vm|kubernetes-nodes|kube-state-metrics"}[24h]), "digest_kind", "up_24h", "job", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (cluster) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"}), "digest_kind", "ready_nodes", "cluster", ".*") or label_replace(count by (cluster) (kube_node_info), "digest_kind", "total_nodes", "cluster", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (cluster, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"}), "digest_kind", "pod_phase", "cluster", ".*") or label_replace(sum by (cluster) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h])), "digest_kind", "restarts_24h", "cluster", ".*") or label_replace(100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="mgmt-node",mode="idle"}[5m]))), "digest_kind", "mgmt_cpu_pct", "job", ".*") or label_replace(100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="mgmt-node"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="mgmt-node"}), "digest_kind", "mgmt_mem_pct", "job", ".*") or label_replace(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="mgmt-node",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="mgmt-node",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}), "digest_kind", "mgmt_disk_pct", "job", ".*")
